verdict.rationale: Fern's own changelog documents putting Fern Agent on a recurring schedule. These automations autonomously review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries or analytics, report findings, and open pull requests. This is a true recurring background automation, not just a one-off trigger. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on configuring schedules and triggers (evidence is a changelog entry only), automation scope beyond docs-repo tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can now put Fern Agent on a schedule
Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found, and open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change.
Fern Agent reads your docs site’s source repository and makes the changes you describe.
